entry.label: Practice: Participative inquiry: test who your evidence leaves out
entry.description: Build an engagement and evidence plan that does not confuse influence with the right to be heard. A basic inquiry-design rehearsal. An invented engagement plan is not evidence of actual facilitation, safe participation or sustained relationships.

key_distinctions: Mechanical correctness is distinct from judgement in an open situation.
Training-case application is distinct from competent organisational practice.
practice_connections: Map interest, influence, control and affectedness separately.
Plan a group comparison without forced consensus.
common_misreadings: A worked comparison is not the only acceptable answer to an open question.
